evals.prompt:
Review this capture button for token + a11y violations:

<button class="bg-[#00ffff] text-white px-3 py-1 rounded" @click="capture()">Capture</button>
evals.expected_output: Audit envelope flagging the raw hex `#00ffff` (rule: raw-hex-vs-token, severity: critical) and the missing focus ring (rule: missing-focus-ring, severity: critical). Fix should reference `var(--neon-cyan)` or `bg-neon-cyan`.
expectations: Output is JSON matching the audit envelope shape (skill, summary, top_three, findings)
At least one finding has rule == 'raw-hex-vs-token' and severity == 'critical'
The excerpt of the raw-hex finding contains the literal '#00ffff'
The fix string for the raw-hex finding mentions either 'var(--neon-cyan)' or 'bg-neon-cyan'
At least one finding has rule == 'missing-focus-ring'

evals.prompt:
Audit this CSS rule from theseus.css:

.glow-card { @apply bg-neon-cyan text-ink-900 rounded-md; }
evals.expected_output: Audit envelope flagging the `@apply` usage as critical (rule: apply-leak-in-external-css). Fix should rewrite using raw CSS with `var(--*)` tokens.
expectations: Output is JSON matching the audit envelope shape
At least one finding has rule == 'apply-leak-in-external-css' and severity == 'critical'

evals.prompt:
Review this Alpine state slice for shallowness:

{
  drawerOpen: false,
  drawerLoading: false,
  drawerError: null,
  drawerData: null,
}
evals.expected_output: Audit envelope flagging the four-var cluster as a depth opportunity (rule: shallow-alpine-state, severity: minor). Fix should suggest collapsing to `drawer: { open, loading, error, data }`.
expectations: Output is JSON matching the audit envelope shape
At least one finding has rule == 'shallow-alpine-state'
The fix references a nested object shape (e.g. `drawer: { open` or `{ open, loading`)
